First, the function will take the input, which is an array of arrays of numbers.

We need to process each row individually.

For each row:

- Check if there is any 1 or 7 in the row.
- If yes, replace all 0s with 8.
- Else, leave the row as is.

So, in code:

function checker(n) {
  // Iterate over each row
  for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) {
    const row = input[i];
    let hasOneOrSeven = false;
    for (let j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
      if (row[j] === 1 || row[j] === 7) {
        hasOneOrSeven = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (hasOneOrSeven) {
      // Replace all 0s with 8
      for (let j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
        if (row[j] === 0) {
          row[j] = 8;
        }
      }
    }
    output[i] = row;
  }
  return output;
}
